title: Troubleshooting: Listing is not Public or Active
text:
## Troubleshooting: Listing is not Public or Active
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000087005
In this article, we will be going over the message that displays on member profiles in specific scenarios with the default wording " Sorry, this Listing is not Public or Active " and how to troubleshoot it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107842770/original/1FHVFFJ-JIGEJve1fUOwB3F2by4TYKTtTA.png?1650384682 | alt: ]
If the message above displays on the member profile, this may be due to a couple of reasons:

## 1) Member Is Not In Active Status
The first thing to check when this message is seen would be the member's status. Under My Members >> Search Members , the status of the member can be seen on its dedicated column:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107842945/original/u9o2xk1ZNYL4MuhNwJmZQfRe98dR1SstaA.png?1650384928 | alt: ]
Member's status can be changed directly under Actions >> Quick Edit :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107843007/original/8ReBK7lPbq5nPAQD3PjdSLTt5K2UQwOAdA.png?1650384976 | alt: ]
To active status:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107843040/original/lWqKavaEQoGgWxf56JA2_G1jpzYj779Ufw.png?1650385013 | alt: ]

## 2) The Member Is In a Non-Searchable Membership Plan
It is important to check the Finance » Membership Plans - Search Visibility settings to see if the member is in a membership plan that is searchable:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107843361/original/6SLjjOdQ0SD9YjVpsysLchtm3XHL4bfUbQ.png?1650385327 | alt: ]
There may be two different scenarios related to the settings above:
- Like in the screenshot above, if the Are These Members Searchable on the Website? setting is set to " No ", the member's profiles will not be visible and the error message will display.
- If the Are These Members Searchable on the Website? setting is set to " Yes " but the Can Unregistered Visitors View These Members in Search Results? setting set to " No ", the member profile will not be visible to the public but will be visible to other members. In this scenario, it is best to log in as a member that is allowed to see these membership plan members (more information about this can be found in the next step).

## 3) Admin Is Logged In As A Member That Is Not Allowed To Search For This Member
Let's assume the following scenario:
The admin of the site is logged in as a member that is in the Featured membership plan and trying to view the profile of a member that is in the Premium plan. In this scenario, it is best to check the Finance » Membership Plans - Search Visibility settings of the membership plan named Featured .
To make sure if the Premium plan is checked under Hidden Member Profile Settings :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107844404/original/KH3sU9xdA3J7I2Tdvdj83n17CwIEs_5Evw.png?1650386445 | alt: ]
